name: kalks-monorepo
description: KALKS website (apps/trader). Log in / sign up hand off to the Kalks Client Area.
//deploy: The 'next' devDependency above is a detection shim, not a build input. Vercel reads the package.json at the deployment Root Directory to identify the framework, and this repo's root is only a monorepo orchestrator. Without it the build fails with 'No Next.js version detected'. Keep the version in step with apps/trader. The alternative, and the cleaner setup, is to set Root Directory to apps/trader in the Vercel project settings, which makes vercel.json and this shim unnecessary.
